Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in its "Updated Understanding" section. While the WebSurfer correctly identified the birthplace as "Naha, Okinawa, Japan" based on the search results, the Planner incorrectly reinterpreted "Naha" as "Okinawa City". Naha is the capital city of Okinawa Prefecture, but its official name is simply "Naha", not "Okinawa City". This hallucination led the Planner to provide an inaccurate final answer ("Okinawa City, Okinawa, Japan") instead of the correct one ("Naha, Okinawa, Japan").
